Re-running preserves banked cells, hand-added fields, and every cell marked source:authored (journey cells, which no guard describes); it only refreshes the derived skeleton.

tests.walked: 2026-07-29 via Playwright MCP (screen) + postgres (row), one walk
asserts: MK3 PII staging: no phone/email pattern in the DOM before contact is initiated - verified on the live listing grid
attribution HOLDS: an inquiry inserted with the caller's own buyer_name lands (buyer_name='Pablo Aguilar', seller_name='Romeo Beltran', status='pending')
attribution FORGE refused: the same insert with buyer_name='Ricardo Morales' is rejected 42501 by mkt_inq_insert CHECK (buyer_name IN (SELECT auth_worker_names()))
zero pollution: probe rows swept, 0 remain
tests.provenance: The J2 state note read 'End-to-end round trip NOT yet walked' while the board showed W:done - the gap that motivated the whole test-bank arc.
tests.note: Neither marketplace_listings nor marketplace_inquiries carries auth_uid; attribution is enforced on the free-text buyer_name via auth_worker_names(). The planned assertion ('auth_uid pinned') was wrong and checking the schema first saved a false finding.

ufai_earned.F5: buyer contacts seller and the inquiry lands with attribution intact - the round trip the journey board had marked done and never walked

tests.walked: 2026-07-29 via Playwright MCP (rendered stars) + postgres (canonical backing)
asserts: every rendered star rating has a canonical backing row-count: rating_avg IS NOT NULL => rating_count > 0
MEASURED 0 violations across 13 sellers (Bryan Garcia 5.00/2, Wilfredo Malabanan 4.75/4, Pablo Aguilar 4.67/3 ...)
the query is written to CATCH the seed defect, not to confirm health: `where rating_avg is not null and coalesce(rating_count,0)=0`
tests.provenance: MK1 seed observation 2026-07-24: a listing showed '3.9 stars, 1 completed' beside 'No reviews yet' - a trust signal standing on nothing. This cell is the standing proof that it cannot return.

ufai_earned.F2: every rendered star rating has a canonical backing row count: rendered == source truth

tests.walked: 2026-07-29 via Playwright MCP on the listing grid
asserts: a ranked list discloses WHY these listings in this order: ordering language present + 1 sort control exposed to the buyer
tests.provenance: MK10: EU P2B Reg. 2019/1150 Art.5 requires ranking disclosure for marketplaces; good practice everywhere.

tests.blocked_reason: VACUOUS TODAY, not verified: 0 sellers carry a response_rate and marketplace_inquiries is empty, so there is no rendered SLA claim to diff against source truth. Recording it as owed rather than banking a green that asserts nothing - a test over an empty denominator proves only that nothing was claimed.
tests.unblock: seed inquiries + a seller response_rate, then assert the rendered 'Responds in ~Xh / Y% reply rate' recomputes from marketplace_inquiries within tolerance.
asserts: the rendered 'Responds in ~Nh' equals a recomputation from the inquiry history
the rendered 'N% reply rate' equals replied/total from the same history
both match the independent arithmetic (3.0h, 0.75), not merely themselves
a seller with inquiries but NO replies keeps BOTH columns NULL - never an invented 0%
tests.provenance: MK9 was recorded owed as VACUOUS: 0 sellers carried a response_rate and marketplace_inquiries was empty, so there was no rendered claim to diff against source truth. That was the right call for a green over an empty denominator - and the wrong place to stop. Checked before assuming: a living producer DOES exist (trg_update_seller_response_stats recomputes both columns from the inquiry history), and the NULLs are the page's honest empty state, not a dead counter. So the probe MANUFACTURES the denominator instead of waiting for one.
tests.note: The recomputation is done independently inside the probe, then pinned to fixed arithmetic (1h+2h+6h)/3 = 3.0 and 3/4 = 0.75 - so a producer that agrees with itself while being wrong still fails. TEETH VERIFIED against the plausible bug this exists to catch: replacing the producer with one that COALESCEs the empty state to 0 made both empty-state assertions report 'NO 0.0' / 'NO 0.00'. A trust signal that lies when a seller is brand new is worse than no signal, and it is the direction a naive COALESCE breaks first.

ufai_earned.F6: a rendered trust figure is diffed against the history that produces it, and the empty state is asserted to stay empty rather than zero

asserts: the client's active job renders a real 'Track provider' control (driven by role+name, not a selector)
the tracker hands the map a provider position at all - so a later 'no movement' result cannot be vacuous
the PROVIDER's own page publishes via watchPosition from its own session (the run logs which path fired)
the WATCHER's map repaints at the NEW coordinate within two 10s poll cycles, with no reload
a provider marker was actually placed on the watcher's map
TEETH: WH_TB_FREEZE=1 parks the publisher and the watcher assertion goes RED - proven, not assumed

tests.note: The tracker POLLS v_service_job_tracking every 10s (marketplace.html ~3584); it is not a Realtime channel. The cell asserts the repaint, which is the user-visible claim, whichever mechanism carries it.

tests.requires: ONLY the browser half now: a real provider grants permission, sw.js receives the push event and notificationclick focuses marketplace-seller.html?tab=services. _ufai_ownership._doc: Which instrument owns each UFAI family, so the bank's ufai % is read correctly. The bank asserts what a RE-RUNNABLE test can hold about transitions, handoffs and truth. It does not re-grade what another gate already walks.

bank_owns.F1 F2 F5 F6: completeness (covered by icon-button-label + aria-label-coverage), correctness, round-trip, degraded states
bank_owns.I1 I2 I3 I4 I5 I6: auth gating, role/permission, tenancy, client validation (covered by input-validation-guard), auditability, safe-by-default

ufai_walk_owns.U1 U2 U5 U6 U7: recognizability, tap targets, a11y, consistency, mobile-field - measured live by tools/validate_service_ufai_deep.py (44px targets, vendored axe, 360-1920 overflow). Duplicating a live browser sweep in a bank cell would duplicate it worse.
ufai_walk_owns.F3 F4: appropriateness and nav-flow - graded 100% on EVERY marketplace page by the UFAI walk with named dims (X1/E4, W1/X3). I first wrote that these had no cell and no evidence; reading the pillar map per PAGE instead of per CLASS showed they were never open.

not_yet_assertable.A1 A2 A6: architecture cells the UFAI walk already grades on these pages.
not_yet_assertable.A3 A4 A5: the only genuinely open cells, and dispositioned with evidence rather than excused: A4 was HUNTED as a concrete stale-hive defect and found absent (a full page load makes the cached value fresh); A3 reduces to the D9 knobs, which have no values yet; A5 is DEMONSTRATED by this arc's denominator growing by itself when a guard changes. _ufai_ownership.ceiling: 48% is the bank's honest share: 12 of 25 classes, every one earned by a named cell or a named existing gate. The other 13 are either owned by the live UFAI walk (which grades them at 100%) or are the three A-series cells recorded owed-with-evidence. A higher number here would mean over-claiming, not more coverage.
